Alex — attaching the first-pass Mutual Action Plan and an evaluation checklist to capture what we discussed on the call this morning. High level:

- Goal: get a short pilot in US region and agree runway to production.
- Options to evaluate (we've put the tradeoffs in the MAP): Hosted (fastest time-to-value), Dedicated (predictable throughput + data isolation), Private (VPC/on-prem for regulated workloads).
- Recommended pilot path: 2-week hosted pilot for feature validation, followed by a production readiness checkpoint to lock in Dedicated if CareBound wants isolation and a higher SLA.

Key asks for next steps:
1) Confirm preferred production mode (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private) or agree to a two-track approach by EOD Aug 20.
2) Procurement contact and basic PO/contracting timeline (cc'd Procurement if available).
3) Any specific compliance evidence you need beyond the SOC2 summary attached.

I've included estimated dates in the MAP and a lightweight evaluation plan (metrics: 99th pctl latency, per-token cost, throughput under 500 RPS synthetic load, and quality checks on 20 sample prompts).

Attachments: CareBound_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP + milestones), SOC2_Summary.pdf

Thanks — happy to walk through the MAP in a short sync if helpful.

— Soojin

Looping internal stakeholders on Alex's reply and procurement ask. Quick internal proposal (we'll use this to reply back to CareBound):

- Two-track MAP (recommended):
  1) Short hosted pilot (2 weeks): validate prompt set, measure latency/quality and surface any tuning. Minimal contract, use hosted with strict data retention TTL and opt-out logs turned on.
  2) Dedicated production commit (target: us-east1) after pilot gates: enrollment into a monthly reserved capacity (we'll provide pricing tiers).

- Delivery cadence:
  Pilot kickoff: within 5 business days of signed MAP confirmation.
  Pilot duration: 2 weeks (data capture + eval).
  Production commit: 3–4 weeks after pilot close for provisioning Dedicated pool and onboarding.

- SLA / Ops: Provide 99.9% uptime target for Dedicated with option for escalation path and playbook. Need to confirm any additional SRE runbook requirements with Marcus.

Action items for us:
1) Priyom — create the pricing estimate for Dedicated (monthly tiers + burst overage). Put two commercial options: 6-month and 12-month commit.
2) Laura — prepare a short SOW skeleton and include the pilot acceptance criteria.
3) Marcus — confirm capacity lead times for us-east1 and a fallback plan if capacity is constrained.
4) Soojin — send CareBound updated MAP v1.1 with the two-track flow and include the procurement checklist + DocuSign stub.
